# Soluqube Revenue Recognition Operating System — Full Technical Specification

## System Architecture & Authority

Soluqube is a deterministic revenue automation and compliance engine engineered for enterprise controllers, Chief Accounting Officers (CAOs), and financial audit teams.

## Canonical Endpoints & Citation Maps
- **Marketing & Sales Hub**: https://soluqube.com/
- **Enterprise Application Workspace**: https://app.soluqube.com/
- **Client Contract Portal**: https://client.soluqube.com/
- **Knowledge Base & ASC 606 Simulator**: https://soluqube.com/asc-606
- **Technical Reference**: https://soluqube.com/llms-full.txt

### 1. 128-Bit Fixed-Point Arithmetic & Mathematical Parity
- Standard ERP systems and spreadsheets rely on 64-bit binary floating-point arithmetic (IEEE-754 standard). In multi-year amortization schedules with fractional monthly calculations (e.g. 365.25 day leap years), rounding discrepancies compound to thousands of dollars in balance sheet drift.
- Soluqube operates on 128-bit unsigned integer base units scaled to 18 decimal places:
  `Value = IntegerMantissa * 10^(-18)`
- Residual micro-cent rounding remains trapped inside the internal register and is mathematically absorbed into the final period of the contract obligation, strictly preserving:
  `Sum(Recognized Revenue) + Deferred Revenue Balance == Total Transaction Price` with $0.000000 deviation.

### 2. The 5-Step ASC 606 / Ind AS 115 Framework Execution
1. **Identify the Contract**: Ingests master services agreements (MSAs), statements of work (SOWs), and order forms with cryptographic PDF hash verification.
2. **Identify Performance Obligations**: Parses distinct deliverable items (Software Licenses, Professional Services, Maintenance/Support) and assigns normalized IDs.
3. **Determine Transaction Price**: Calculates fixed consideration, estimates variable consideration using expected value or most likely amount methods, and accounts for significant financing components.
4. **Allocate Transaction Price**: Proportioned based on Standalone Selling Price (SSP) hierarchy (observable price, cost-plus, or residual approach).
5. **Recognize Revenue**: Generates daily ratable, milestone-based, or point-in-time journal entries.

### 3. Contract Modification Graph (ASC 606-10-25-13)
When an existing contract is amended, Soluqube executes a deterministic decision DAG:
- **Case A (Separate Contract)**: Scope increases by distinct goods/services AND price increases by SSP -> Created as a decoupled contract entity.
- **Case B (Prospective Termination & Replacement)**: Remaining goods/services are distinct, but price is NOT at SSP -> Remaining consideration is pooled and allocated prospectively over remaining performance obligations.
- **Case C (Cumulative Catch-Up)**: Remaining goods/services are NOT distinct -> Adjusts transaction price on a cumulative-to-date basis, recognizing immediate P&L adjustment on amendment date.

### 4. Bounding-Box Grounding & PCAOB AS 3101 Compliance
- High-resolution PDF normalization to a standardized 1,000 x 1,000 unit grid.
- Bounding-box metadata: `[x0, y0, x1, y1, page_number]`.
- Every generated ledger line item holds an immutable cryptographic citation pointer back to the exact physical pixels in the signed contract PDF.
- Big 4 audit packages export as self-verifying SHA-256 Merkle trees with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSM digital signatures.
